# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. The pull-request `windows` job is the deliberate exception: it runs Windows Node under Wine on hosted Linux and blocks `all checks passed`; `windows-native` defaults to `windows-2025`, may use the named enterprise pool when `DSH_CI_ENTERPRISE_RUNNERS_ENABLED=true`, and uses `[self-hosted, dsh-win-ci, windows]` under `DSH_CI_FAILOVER_WINDOWS=selfhosted` only for same-repository, non-Dependabot pull requests, while reporting independently. Linux failover has the same fork exclusion. Master standby drills require `DSH_CI_SELF_HOSTED_STANDBY_ENABLED=true`; see the [portable runner defaults](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-02-portable-ci-runner-defaults.md) and [failover runbook](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-07-26-ci-failover-runbook.md).
